title: Signature on a T-shirt
slide_intent: Scale a brand down to a wearable detail because recognition should not depend on filling the whole surface.
strategic_value: A small dark signature on pale fabric can let Wise appear with restraint in a human setting.
demonstration: A close crop of a pale T-shirt shows the Wise signature at the chest with a small paragraph beneath it.
practical_value: Compare a compact signature treatment with the collection’s oversized headline applications.

content_islands.spec: Place the dark signature above the tiny supporting paragraph.

content_islands.name: Fabric and body
content_islands.spec: Retain folds, light and torso crop to show real placement.
